scripts.build:static: npm run export:static-data && tsc -p static/tsconfig.json && vite build --config static/vite.config.ts
scripts.deploy:static: npm run build:static && cd static && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 deploy
scripts.db:migrate:static: cd static && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 d1 migrations apply framing-letters --remote
scripts.seed:d1-templates: tsx scripts/seed-d1-templates.ts && cd static && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 d1 execute framing-letters --remote --file .seed-templates.sql
